title: Light Uruguayan Cacao Pasta
description: A fresh and creamy Uruguayan dish featuring cacao and pasta water emulsion, egg free friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cacao powder and a splash of the pasta water to make a smooth emulsion.
Add the cacao emulsion to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 2 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Stir in the parmesan cheese and cook until melted and smooth.
Drain the pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to coat with the cacao sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
